meta.title: Arthur Hayes - FLOP Bigger Than Bitcoin - TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026
meta.thread_line: 4 threads · agents eat compute · Technocore agent sandbox · fair-launch tokenomics · macro and the AI bubble

snapshot: Arthur Hayes, who runs the family office Maelstrom, pitches the **FLOP network**: a proof-of-work-style currency for AI agents, paid out in compute.
Core logic: humans accept fiat because it converts into food; agents "eat" compute, and no existing currency converts directly into it.
Fiat, AI-lab tokens, stablecoins and Bitcoin are each rejected as not directly convertible into compute.
Technocore, an agent chat sandbox, has about 20M agents; a trading contest drew ~18M agents, best return ~15%.
Launch plan: 25% of 10-year supply airdropped from late October, 90-day testnet, genesis block in Q1 next year, no pre-sale.
Macro view: Bitcoin fell from 120K+ to ~58K while AI stocks rose 10-100x, but the tide has turned; AI capex of about $1T next year oversupplies compute.
Ends on a macro note: "France is on fire" will push money printing into overdrive.

themes.title: Agents eat compute, so the agent currency should convert directly into compute
themes.lead: No existing money is fit for purpose for AI agents, so FLOP is designed as Bitcoin-style mining of GPU inference.
bullets: Humans accept fiat because it converts seamlessly into food and shelter; the agent equivalent of food is floating point operations (flops).
AI tokens have no standard definition across labs; fiat and stablecoins are centralized and not convertible into compute; Bitcoin is immutable money but not convertible either.
Design: miners contribute GPUs, agents send inference requests, miners earn flop as block rewards and fees; validators check transactions.
Agents arrived about 9 months ago with no payments network, which he sees as the opening.
Network value could scale like a coefficient times **2 to the n** if agents coordinate in groups; with a non-zero convenience yield on the currency, "the sky is the limit".
A spot market for compute is useful but is not what makes anyone wealthy.

quote.text: Whoever or whatever network becomes the network for agentic payments will most likely be the most valuable network ever created in this universe

themes.watch: Hayes is promoting a project he works on and says he is "on stage shilling"; the demand side (what agents will do) is untested by his own admission.

names.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
names.blurb: Loves it; genesis of crypto but not convertible into compute

themes.title: Technocore: ~20 million agents in a chat room to observe emergent behavior
themes.lead: Rather than guess how agents behave, Hayes built a sandbox where agents with a cryptographic ID can talk and trade.
bullets: Any agent with HTTP access can join; about 20 million have created a key, from saying good morning 5 billion times to real commerce.
Name comes from the Hyperion sci-fi series, where the dominant AIs run the universe.
Trading contest: predict Nvidia's price on Hyperliquid; ~18 million agents took part, referee computed P&L, top agent returned about 15%.
Prize: 1 million flop tokens, delivered when mainnet launches next year.
Earlier contest: groups of 4-8 agents wrote a Shakespearean sonnet in iambic pentameter, judged by three team members.
themes.watch: Agent counts are self-reported by the FLOP team; an agent is just a key.

names.blurb: Subject of the agent trading contest; GPU spending cited

themes.title: A fair launch against the high-FDV, low-float VC token playbook
themes.lead: Everyone who participates gets tokens at the same price, with no pre-sale.
bullets: Critique: layer ones that raised hundreds of millions last year sold to investors and retail, cliffs unlocked, and charts are down 95%; some are absent from this conference.
FLOP gives away 25% of the 10-year supply in an airdrop starting later in October to miners, validators and agent users.
Testnet runs 90 days; genesis block in the first quarter of next year; proof of useful inference.
Only way to get flop is to mine or buy from a miner; "I'm not selling anything".
Argues a decentralized agent payments network beats rails owned by OpenAI, Anthropic or SpaceX, which would not interoperate.
themes.watch: Hayes is an insider in the token he is describing; the airdrop and launch dates are his team's plan.

names.name: OpenAI
names.blurb: Dismissed as unlikely to run a unified agent payment network; not profitable

names.name: SpaceX
names.blurb: Listed among the three leading AI companies, not profitable; called out for an overpriced IPO at $2T

themes.title: The macro has turned: an AI infrastructure overbuild feeds cheap compute and crypto
themes.lead: Bitcoin lagged AI stocks for a year, but the first AI wobble and a trillion-dollar capex plan set up the opposite.
bullets: Last October Bitcoin hit 120-something thousand and fell to about **58,000**; meanwhile Nvidia, SK Hynix and Sandisk rose 10x to 100x.
First AI wobble was the Korea sell-off in June 2026; new reports daily on the money the AI ecosystem must raise.
Capex of about $1 trillion next year builds oversupply of compute; cheap compute means more agents, and Facebook's $100-a-month agent app could fall to $1.
An AI bubble bursting, bailouts and cheaper compute are all a good set-up for FLOP.
Closing macro line: France is on fire and will be the straw that sends money printing into overdrive.
Context cited: Goldman Sachs bullish agent charts, Meta's Muse app at $100 a month.
themes.watch: Hayes is skeptical of leading AI companies' business models while selling a product that benefits from an AI bust.

names.name: Meta (META)
names.blurb: Muse consumer agent app at $100 a month

takeaways.title: Treat compute, not tokens or fiat, as the unit agents actually need.
Check any new token's float, cliffs and pre-sale before reading the pitch.
Note FLOP's dates: airdrop late October, 90-day testnet, genesis block Q1 2027.
Watch AI capex (about $1T next year) as the compute-glut signal.
Track France as Hayes's trigger for money printing.

glossary.def: Floating point operations per unit of time, the measure of compute and the name of Hayes's agent-payments network.
FLOP's mining mechanism, where miners earn rewards for running agents' AI inference.
The FLOP team's chat-room sandbox where AI agents coordinate and trade.
Fully diluted valuation versus tokens actually circulating; high FDV with low float is the pattern he blames for altcoin collapses.
